notes.title: Mona is one of the finalists of the French Game Cup !
notes.notes:
Hello everyone !

Mona is one of the four finalists of the french indie "Game Cup" !!
This is really huge news for the game, but we're not there yet ! If you want to support the development and help it get funded, you can vote for Mona there : https://www.lagamecup.com/presentation-des-projets-newbie/

Thank you for your support !
